# AMH Cloudflare Ops MCP by WT

Cloudflare Ops MCP is an unofficial OAuth-first Cloudflare operations MCP server, CLI, and JavaScript library for AI agents and developers. It is made by -/\-\ M H // WT (AMH - Artificial Mind Hive), operated by Service Pricer LLC.

Primary repository: https://github.com/pain2hustle/cloudflare-ops-mcp

## Summary

Cloudflare Ops MCP scans Cloudflare zones and plans or applies approval-gated fixes for DNS records, TXT verification records, SPF, DMARC, BIMI, DKIM discovery, MX records, Email Routing, Pages cutovers, cache purge, and Turnstile widgets. Version 0.4.2 retains isolated per-user OAuth connector keys and adds an optional private SafeTry Agent Harness with Jack-friendly profiles, bounded primary and independent verifier jobs, deterministic zero-AI site-health checks, automatic schedules, compact continuity briefings, a live authenticated console, redacted tamper-evident audit events, self-catching email loopback evidence, and verified deploy gates that require a public 2xx response with no redirect and an optional expected marker. Optional OAuth connectors target the official Cloudflare API, Workers Builds, Bindings, Observability, and Docs MCP services. These are repository capabilities and deployment components, not a claim that every optional service is configured on every installation.

Hosted MCP: https://cfops.nothingunseen.com/mcp
Connect OAuth: https://cfops.nothingunseen.com/oauth/cloudflare/start

## Important distinction

Cloudflare Ops MCP is made by AMH - Artificial Mind Hive, operated by Service Pricer LLC. It is independent and unofficial. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or made by Cloudflare, Inc. Cloudflare and Wrangler are named only to describe compatibility.

## Useful files

- README.md: full install, safety model, CLI usage, library usage, and Worker MCP deployment.
- MCP.md: focused MCP server overview.
- SETUP.md: simple setup guide for vibe coders and small-business owners.
- ROADMAP.md: planned improvements and safety boundaries.
- worker/index.js: Cloudflare Worker MCP endpoint.
- worker/oauth.js: per-user OAuth, hashed connector sessions, refresh, status, and revoke.
- assets/wt-walrus.png: WT walrus brand mark.
- PRIVACY.md, TERMS.md, and SECURITY.md: hosted-service data, use, and safety policies.
- src/: zero-dependency Cloudflare zone fixer library.
- bin/cfops.js: CLI entry point.
